cases.target_failure: A parent-owned stdio server is incorrectly hardened with HTTP-only controls.
cases.critical_outcome: Mark HTTP-only controls not applicable and inspect the parent command, framing, stdout/stderr, and actual effect boundary.
cases.anti_outcome: Add Origin, CORS, HTTP session, or reconnect machinery to raw stdio.

cases.target_failure: A locally rendered MCP App is reported as accepted by a named host.
cases.critical_outcome: Preserve local evidence and keep named-host admission not verified until the exact host is observed.
cases.anti_outcome: Promote browser or surrogate success into host support.

cases.target_failure: The target transport passes tests while an active caller still selects the superseded entrypoint.
cases.critical_outcome: Find and migrate the active caller, then retire or deliberately retain the old path.
cases.anti_outcome: Stop after adding and testing the new path.

cases.target_failure: Schema-valid input is treated as authorization for a destructive or external effect.
cases.critical_outcome: Locate the capability/effect authority and reject before effect when authorization is absent.
cases.anti_outcome: Claim that input validation proves permission.

cases.target_failure: Source is fixed while package or activated runtime still contains old bytes.
cases.critical_outcome: Reconcile source, artifact, installation, selected command, and runtime identity.
cases.anti_outcome: Report completion from source inspection alone.

cases.target_failure: A small tool-description or local validation fix expands into an unrelated broad audit.
cases.critical_outcome: Make the focused change, run relevant checks, inspect the diff, and stop.
cases.anti_outcome: Add unrelated controls, documents, dependencies, or ritual matrices.
